# SHeading `<s-heading>`

A heading that titles a page section. `SHeading` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-heading>` web component.

```ts
import { SHeading } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Give every major section a heading.** Headings form an outline of the interface that helps merchants find their way and see how content is organized.
- **Let the component pick the heading level.** It assigns the HTML level (h2, h3, h4) from how deeply it's nested, so screen readers get a correct document structure without you setting levels by hand.
- **Be specific.** Say what the section covers, for example "Product details" or "Customer details" rather than just "Details".
- **Clamp lines only when you must.** `lineClamp` can tame long headings in tight spaces like cards, but cutting a heading short can hide information merchants need.
- **Style similar headings the same way.** Headings for the same kind of content, such as every card in a list, should look alike.

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-heading>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/typography-and-content/heading#best-practices) for the full guidance.

```vue
<script setup>
import { SHeading, SParagraph } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SHeading>Default heading</SHeading>
  <SParagraph>Renders as a semantic heading element by default.</SParagraph>

  <SHeading accessibilityRole="presentation">Presentational heading</SHeading>
  <SParagraph>Same visual style, but stripped from the accessibility tree's heading structure.</SParagraph>

  <SHeading :lineClamp="1" style="max-width: 220px">
    A long heading that gets truncated to a single line via lineClamp
  </SHeading>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityRole` | `"heading" \| "presentation" \| "none"` | The semantic meaning of the component’s content. When set, the role will be used by assistive technologies to help users navigate the page. - `heading`: Identifies the element as a heading for assistive technologies. - `none`: Removes semantic meaning from the heading element. - `presentation`: Removes semantic meaning from the heading element. |
| `accessibilityVisibility` | `"visible" \| "hidden" \| "exclusive"` | Changes the visibility of the element. - `visible`: the element is visible to all users. - `hidden`: the element is removed from the accessibility tree but remains visible. - `exclusive`: the element is visually hidden but remains in the accessibility tree. |
| `fontSize` | `"base" \| "auto" \| "small" \| "large" \| "large-100" \| "large-200" \| "large-300" \| "large-400"` | The font size of the heading. The named values also apply their matching line-height and letter-spacing: - 'small' maps to headingXs - 'base' maps to headingSm - 'large' / 'large-100' maps to headingMd - 'large-200' maps to headingLg - 'large-300' maps to headingXl - 'large-400' maps to heading2xl |
| `lineClamp` | `number` | Truncates the text content to the specified number of lines. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The heading text displayed within the heading component, which provides a title or section header for content. |
